about: Registry of data sources for the Armenia new-builds map. Skills read and update it: status ok|degraded|blocked|dead|candidate, method, and notes on quirks. Keep entries short and factual.

sources.name: karucapatoxic.am
sources.method: Next.js RSC payload (listBuildings on /en, detail /en/<id>, JSON-LD). Coordinates from Google embed !2z marker, not !2d/!3d centre.

sources.name: construction.am
sources.method: HTML pages with Google Maps embeds; many completed/stale listings (2019-2022 prices).

sources.name: dignisi.am
sources.method: Next.js SSR; sitemap.xml lists all /en/projects/*; project pages carry schema.org ApartmentComplex JSON-LD (geo, address). /api/ disallowed by robots.txt - do not use. Includes Dubai/Cyprus/Batumi projects to skip.

sources.name: geoln.com
sources.method: HTML; stale prices, completion dates often past.

sources.name: ac-box.com
sources.method: Every page embeds the full catalogue JSON.

sources.name: yerevan.etagi.com
sources.method: HTML; USD figure sometimes equals AMD thousands (e.g. $489 = 510,000 AMD).

sources.name: myhome.am
sources.method: JSON API POST /API/v1/buildings/filter_v2, /API/v1/builders/{id}; unit-level prices (use unsold units only).

sources.name: redgroup.am
sources.method: JSON API /api/projects?page=N; product.status 'sold' must be excluded from prices; API returns only a ~12-unit sample.

sources.name: novostroiki-yerevan.com
sources.method: sitemap + markdown project pages; copies karucapatoxic coordinates (viewport centre, ~100 m east bias).

sources.name: ar-go.am
sources.method: Armenian-only pages, Yandex map coordinates, start/end dates. robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot / ai-train=no: fetch politely for this dataset only.

sources.name: acba.am
sources.method: Armenian partner cards: address, status, floors, completion, price, contacts.

sources.name: evoca.am
sources.method: Developer/project cards with address and phone only; many placeholder coordinates.

sources.name: byblosbankarmenia.am
sources.method: 4 cards, address only.

sources.name: developer websites (136)
sources.method: Agent-driven per developer; list in scraper/developers_master.json (projects_url). Output developer_projects_b*.json.

sources.name: datalex.am
sources.method: POST json.php getGridDataList (civil, bankruptcy, administrative, criminal, payment_order); fuzzy search, filter to exact party names; case link ?app=AppCaseSearch&case_id=ID. <=1 req/4 s.

sources.name: karg.am
sources.method: karg.am/company/<tax id>: status, founders, enforcement cases.
sources.notes: Answers 403 to every request since 2026-09-21, browser included; the crawl's cached pages remain. Registry links now point at e-register.moj.am/hy/search/companies?query=<tax id>, which opens the company.

sources.name: Open-Meteo elevation
sources.method: api.open-meteo.com/v1/elevation batches of 100; rate-limits (429) - back off.

sources.name: OSM Nominatim / Overpass
sources.method: 1 req/s max; province/district polygons in scraper/geo/.

sources.name: 2gis.am
sources.method: ~191 new builds but client-rendered with keyed API - not usable without a key.

sources.name: list.am
sources.method: 403 to automated requests.

sources.name: spyur.am
sources.method: Returns no results to scripts; usable manually for company pages.

sources.name: inecobank.am developer offers
sources.method: 403 to scripts.

sources.name: bnakaran.am
sources.method: Domain does not resolve.
